title: Happy kitten
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <polygon points='26,34 30,12 46,26' fill='#f7a544'/>
  <polygon points='74,34 70,12 54,26' fill='#f7a544'/>

  <polygon points='69,30 67,18 57,27' fill='#ffc9a0'/>

  <ellipse cx='50' cy='52' rx='28' ry='24' fill='#f9b04a'/>

  <circle cx='68' cy='60' r='7' fill='#ffd98a'/>

  <ellipse cx='40' cy='48' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#3ad0c8'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='48' rx='5' ry='6' fill='#3ad0c8'/>

  <line x1='86' y1='62' x2='70' y2='62' stroke='#ffe6b0' stroke-width='2' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='84' rx='20' ry='14' fill='#f9b04a'/>
  <!-- chest -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='86' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#ffe2ad'/>
  <!-- paws -->
  <circle cx='38' cy='95' r='5' fill='#ffe2ad'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='95' r='5' fill='#ffe2ad'/>
